scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.test: npx tsx -e "import { runMioTestSuite } from './src/tests/systemTests.ts'; import { runResearchConflictTests } from './src/tests/researchConflictTests.ts'; import { runToolRouterTests } from './src/tests/toolRouterTests.ts'; import { runModelRouterTests } from './src/tests/modelRouterTests.ts'; import { runAiProxyTests } from './src/tests/aiProxyTests.ts'; import { runContextContinuityTests } from './src/tests/contextContinuityTests.ts'; import { runTaskRuntimeTests } from './src/tests/taskRuntimeTests.ts'; import { runTaskSchedulerTests } from './src/tests/taskSchedulerTests.ts'; import { runResourceGovernanceTests } from './src/tests/resourceGovernanceTests.ts'; import { runScopedAuthorizationTests } from './src/tests/scopedAuthorizationTests.ts'; import { runCapabilityGatewayTests } from './src/tests/capabilityGatewayTests.ts'; import { runDesktopWorkspaceBridgeTests } from './src/tests/desktopWorkspaceBridgeTests.ts'; import { runKnowledgeIngestionTests } from './src/tests/knowledgeIngestionTests.ts'; import { runProjectKnowledgeIndexTests } from './src/tests/projectKnowledgeIndexTests.ts'; import { runKnowledgeGovernanceWorkflowTests } from './src/tests/knowledgeGovernanceWorkflowTests.ts'; (async () => { const runners = [runMioTestSuite, async () => runResearchConflictTests(), runToolRouterTests, runModelRouterTests, runAiProxyTests, runContextContinuityTests, runTaskRuntimeTests, runTaskSchedulerTests, runResourceGovernanceTests, runScopedAuthorizationTests, runCapabilityGatewayTests, runDesktopWorkspaceBridgeTests, runKnowledgeIngestionTests, runProjectKnowledgeIndexTests, runKnowledgeGovernanceWorkflowTests]; const results = []; for (const run of runners) results.push(await run()); const passed = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.passed, 0); const total = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.total, 0); console.log('TOTAL VALIDATION: ' + passed + '/' + total); if (passed !== total) process.exit(1); })().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });"
